doc.title: Case Packer Vacuum Pump Inspection
doc.file: MP-502 Case Packer Vacuum Pump Inspection.pdf
doc.purpose: Find a failing vacuum pump before it stops the case packer.

roles.name: Maintenance Planner
roles.does: Orders spare parts and schedules repairs.

references.as_written: WI-213 Case Packer Setup and Glue Check

parameters.quote: More than 70 degrees C, or more than 15 degrees above last month, is a fail.

parameters.what: maximum bearing temperature rise since last month
parameters.quote: More than 70 degrees C, or more than 15 degrees above last month, is a fail.
Read the vacuum at the pump inlet with the erector idle: at least 0.7 bar of vacuum.
Monthly task in the maintenance system.
Keep at least one bearing VP-BRG-6205 in stores.

rules.statement: Case packers are locked out using the group lock box.
rules.quote: Lock out the case packer using the group lock box, as described in SP-402, Rev B.

unsure.what: Vacuum reading is taken at the pump inlet with the erector idle (0.7 bar), WI-213 reads at the erector cups (0.6 bar)
unsure.why: Different measuring points; document does not say how they relate
